newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's GMA TV sells Express Telecom stake.
newsitem.headline: Manila's GMA TV sells Express Telecom stake.

text.p: The Philippine's GMA Network Inc said on Friday it has sold its 12.38 percent stake in cellular phone company Express Telecommunications Co Inc to Mayon Holdings Inc, a local unlisted firm.
Express Telecommunications is a unit of Benpres Holdings Corp.

"We decided to get out of Extelcom and use the proceeds of the sale of our equity for our expansion programme which we intend to complete this year," GMA executive vice president Antonio Seva said in a statement.
Although the statement did not give the amount of the sale, a company official told Reuters it was worth 110 million pesos.
Benpres last year bought Marifil Holdings Inc which in turn owns 46.62 percent of Extelcom. Benpres is the largest shareholder of the mobile phone company.
No details were given on GMA's expansion plans.
